purpose: Validate coverage and reference integrity for the canonical classroom task runtime set.

reference_checks.rule: Every runtime task concept_id must resolve to concept_taxonomy.json.
Every runtime teaching_move_id must be canonical. The invalid generalise move in the superseded Algebra file was removed from the runtime set.

Runtime representation IDs use the extended representation catalog/reference registry: number/place-value models, number line, arrays, bar/area models, pattern/equality/ratio models, measurement/time/money models, geometric models, data displays and probability line.
Task source IDs resolve to registered curriculum, guidance or research sources; source attachment supports rationale and does not turn the task into a claimed national norm.
Superseded files are excluded by task_manifest.json.
Tasks with framework timing differences retain evidence notes or are gated by grade_resolution_rules.json.

language_note: Task titles and teacher prompts are stored in Chinese and English. Internal fields such as purpose, expected_thinking and listen_for remain canonical English metadata in v1 and must not be exposed untranslated in a Chinese UI.
